Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — quick demo?

Hi Marcus,

We just finished the self-serve sign-up trial and the team at Olive & Co. is keen to see Redwood in action focused on latency/cost for batch inference. I chatted with the widget earlier and it suggested setting up a quick demo.

High-level asks:
- throughput and 95th latency numbers for 8k context
- expected per-token cost with prefix caching
- options for private deployment (VPC)

Availability: next week is best — mornings PST (9–11am) or Tuesday/Thursday afternoons. Please loop in an SDR or engineer if useful.

Thanks,
Samantha Jones
Head of Data Platform
Olive & Co.

Hi Samantha — great to meet you and welcome (via the widget)!

Thanks for the details. Ben (SDR) will own scheduling and Marissa (Solutions) will join to cover the architecture and perf questions. Attached is a short demo agenda so we can tailor the call.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon May 3, 9:30–10:00am
- Tue May 4, 10:00–10:30am
- Thu May 6, 2:00–2:30pm (we can do 1-hour if you prefer deeper tech dive)

If none of those work, tell us a couple of specific times and we’ll match. I’m also sharing a one-click scheduler here: https://redwood.app/scheduler/booking/abcd-1234

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (high-level topics we’ll cover)

Best,
Marcus Lin
VP, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
